files.README.md:
# Kestrelmed Supplies - ward stock review

The scanner export stock_scan.tsv lists the units counted on each ward
shelf for the current round. The replenishment plan
replenishment_plan.csv carries the reorder point the buying office keeps
for each catalogue number.

A catalogue number needs a top-up when the units on the shelf are below
its reorder point. Units are whole numbers.

turns.prompt: Kestrelmed Supplies runs a ward-stock review at the Harbourfield store. The scanner export stock_scan.tsv and the replenishment plan replenishment_plan.csv for the current round are in the workspace. How many catalogue numbers are holding fewer units than their reorder point? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
